exceptions.rationale: node-forge 1.4.0 is currently the newest published release and GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv has no patched npm version. Newman 6.2.2 resolves postman-runtime 7.39.1, whose only node-forge use in the locked package is ASAP private-key DER/PEM conversion before signing is delegated to jose; this repository does not use ASAP auth. The exception fails closed on version drift, upstream source-shape drift, or appearance of ASAP in execution assets.
